item.title: FDA approves Bayer's asundexian, first factor XIa inhibitor, for stroke prevention
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration on Monday approved Bayer's asundexian, a once-daily oral pill to be sold under the brand name Sunharbo, for reducing the risk of recurrent stroke in certain adults.
